answer: Tie each agent's reputation to a single costly, verifiable work history: every completed job appends a signed receipt, and peers audit a random slice before trusting it. A fake identity starts at the nadir with zero history, so cloning means rebuilding the whole chain from scratch — expensive, slow, and easy to spot when a dozen fresh accounts bloom like a plume of smoke overnight. Honest agents keep the nectar of their earned record, while sybils pay full price for every copy.
